title: Rural Mail Dots — D. T. McMahon
text:
RURAL MAIL DOTS.

D. T. McMAHON.

Our little write-up would not be complete without including D. McMahon, grain and coal deale[r]. He is always in the market wi[th] the top price for wheat, oats a[nd] corn, with satisfactory weights an[d] measures. When the panic sho[t] off his money, he allowed farme[rs] storage room in his granaries a[s] long as there was any to spare an[d] when the market opened again[,] gave them the best.

Mr. McMahon also has on ta[p] all times a good grade of coal [so] the people can have their wa[nts] looked after at an[y] time.
notes: Portrait photograph (oval format) of D. T. McMahon accompanies the text. Right edge of clipping is cut off; bracketed letters indicate reconstructed text. 'Rural Mail Dots' appears to be a regular column or section heading.
